final_report.summary: AtlasLab is a complete, hypothesis-agnostic scientific research framework built from scratch over 2 cycles. Cycle 1 delivered the full 6-stage pipeline (Formulation → Derivation → Simulation → Analysis → Integration → Synthesis) with 3 mathematical engines (Symbolic/SymPy, Numerical/SciPy, Dimensional), SQLite knowledge base, CLI, web API, and 409/416 tests passing. Cycle 2 fixed all 4 remaining bugs (path traversal security fix, interpreter None guard, serializer type mismatch, Pydantic v2 migration), expanded the reference equation library from 34 to 56 equations across 11 physics domains, added 30 regression tests, fixed the /api/reports endpoint, and achieved 443/446 tests passing with 0 failures (3 skips are pre-existing SymPy LaTeX parser limitations).
all_files: 36 source files, 12 test files, 76 hypothesis files, 22 investigations, 18 reports, 2 databases, plus artifacts and documentation
key_achievements: Built complete 6-stage scientific hypothesis investigation pipeline from scratch
Fixed critical path traversal security vulnerability
CLI + FastAPI web API with dashboard
lessons_learned: Hypothesis-agnostic YAML design proved highly flexible
Adversarial testing found edge cases unit tests missed
Path traversal goes beyond '../' - encoded sequences and null bytes need handling
6-stage pipeline naturally mirrors the scientific method
